name: SCHEMA_STRUCTURAL_VALIDATION
hypothesis: H1: Schema validation (additionalProperties:false + required fields + enum enforcement) covers the full structural surface of WUL claim correctness, but cannot touch semantic admissibility.
experiment: Enumerate what wul_claim_schema_v0.json can assert automatically vs. what it delegates to $comment fields.

automatable_by_schema: truth_status is one of the 8-state enum
admission_state is one of the 7-state enum
not_automatable_by_schema: whether evidence[] items are credible sources
whether truth_status elevation is warranted by evidence quality
whether SPECULATIVE ceiling of PENDING_REVIEW is respected at transition time
whether terminal=true is set at correct moment (not just type-checked)
whether evidence_hash matches actual source content

membrane_verdict: SCHEMA_AUTO_EVAL = structural gate only. Semantic promotion is reducer-domain.
